title: 자판기에서 음료 사기: 얼마예요? 어디에 넣어요?
objective: By the end, you can read the price, the sold-out light, the money slots and the return button on a vending machine, and buy a drink.
summary: Learners read the buttons, labels and small notices on a Korean drink vending machine.
note: These labels are examples. Real machines may use slightly different words.

task.title: Read the vending machine
task.line: Use the words and the sticker from page 1 to find the information you need.

steps.en: put in money (or tap a card)

items.text: Put coins into the small round slot.
Put bills into the long, flat slot.
Hold your card on the card reader to pay.
This window shows how much money is in the machine now.
When this light is on, you can't buy that drink.
Press or pull it to get your money back.
The extra money comes out at the bottom.

sections.heading: Read the sticker on the machine
paragraphs: [안내]  지폐는 1,000원만 사용할 수 있습니다.  카드 사용 가능.  돈이 안 나오면 반환 버튼을 누르세요.
Tip: Look at the price and the red 품절 light first. 사용할 수 있습니다 means "you can use it," and 사용 가능 means "usable."

exercises: Choose the right word (반환 / 카드 / 품절): ① You put in money, but you want your money back. ② You have no cash.
Read the screen and write the drink you can buy now: 금액 1,000원 | 물 800원 | 콜라 1,500원 | 커피 1,200원 (품절)
Read the label and answer Yes or No: 「동전: 100원, 500원 / 지폐: 1,000원, 5,000원」 ① Can you use a 500-won coin? ② Can you use a 10,000-won bill?
Put the sentences in the right order: 음료를 꺼내요. / 버튼을 눌러요. / 돈을 넣어요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the box (차가운 / 거스름돈 / 꺼내는 곳): ① 커피는 1,200원이에요. 2,000원을 넣었어요. ____ 800원이 나와요. ② 오늘 너무 더워요. ____ 음료를 사요.
answers: 물 (water). 콜라 is 1,500원, more than 1,000원, and 커피 is 품절.
돈을 넣어요. → 버튼을 눌러요. → 음료를 꺼내요.
